name: 現在簡單式第三人稱
note: 主詞為第三人稱單數時,現在簡單式動詞加 -s/-es;否定與疑問用 does + 原形。

items.q: She ___ to work by bus every day.
items.ex: 主詞 she 為第三人稱單數,習慣動作用現在簡單式,go 加 -es。

items.q: My manager ___ coffee; he only drinks tea.
items.ex: 第三人稱單數否定用 doesn't + 原形動詞。

items.q: ___ your company offer remote work?
items.ex: 主詞 your company 為單數,一般動詞疑問句用 Does。

items.q: The train ___ at 7:45 every morning.
items.ex: 時刻表與固定習慣用現在簡單式,單數主詞加 -s。

items.q: He ___ his emails first thing every morning.
items.ex: every morning 表習慣,he 後動詞加 -s。

items.q: This app ___ a lot of battery.
items.ex: this app 為單數,現在簡單式動詞加 -s;be 動詞不可直接接原形。

items.q: Our office usually ___ at 9 a.m.
items.ex: office 為單數,usually 表習慣,動詞加 -s。

items.q: My sister ___ in Taichung, but she works in Taipei.
items.ex: my sister 為第三人稱單數,動詞加 -s。

items.q: Tom ___ how to use this software.
items.ex: know 是狀態動詞,不用進行式;Tom 單數加 -s。

items.q: My father ___ the news every evening.
items.ex: 字尾 -ch 的動詞第三人稱單數加 -es。

name: 現在進行式 vs 現在簡單式
note: 現在正在發生或這段期間暫時的動作用 am/is/are + V-ing;習慣與狀態動詞用現在簡單式。

items.q: Please be quiet — I ___ to a client on the phone right now.
items.ex: right now 表正在進行,用 am + V-ing。

items.q: Look! It ___ again. Take an umbrella.
items.ex: Look! 表示眼前正在發生,用現在進行式。

items.q: I usually drive to work, but this week I ___ the MRT because my car is in the garage.
items.ex: this week 的暫時狀況用現在進行式。

items.q: My brother ___ coffee every morning.
items.ex: every morning 是習慣,用現在簡單式。

items.q: What ___ right now? Your screen looks frozen.
items.ex: right now 問正在做什麼,疑問句 be 動詞放主詞前。

items.q: The team ___ a new feature at the moment, so the release is delayed.
items.ex: at the moment 表目前正在進行。

items.q: I ___ what you mean.
items.ex: understand 是狀態動詞,不用進行式。

items.q: Prices ___ quickly at the moment.
items.ex: at the moment 用進行式;prices 為複數用 are。

items.q: She can't come to the phone; she ___ a shower.
items.ex: 此刻正在洗澡,用現在進行式。

items.q: This soup ___ delicious.
items.ex: taste 表「嚐起來」是狀態動詞,用簡單式。

name: 過去簡單式與不規則動詞
note: 已結束的過去時間(yesterday, last week, ago, in 2024)用過去簡單式,注意不規則動詞。

items.q: We ___ a great hotel in Tokyo last month.
items.ex: last month 是過去時間;find 的過去式為 found。

items.q: I ___ my laptop at the café yesterday.
items.ex: yesterday 用過去式;leave → left。

items.q: She ___ the report two days ago.
items.ex: ago 搭配過去簡單式;write → wrote。

items.q: They ___ to Kaohsiung by high-speed rail last weekend.
items.ex: last weekend 用過去式;go → went。

items.q: ___ you see the news last night?
items.ex: 過去式一般動詞疑問句用 Did + 原形。

items.q: I ___ the meeting because I was sick.
items.ex: didn't 後接原形動詞。

items.q: He ___ his phone and the screen cracked.
items.ex: 短母音加子音結尾,過去式重複字尾:dropped。

items.q: The company ___ 50 new engineers in 2024.
items.ex: in 2024 是明確過去時間,用過去式。

items.q: We ___ dinner at a night market after work yesterday.
items.ex: yesterday 用過去式;eat → ate。

items.q: The meeting ___ at 3 p.m. and ended at 5.
items.ex: begin 過去式 began,begun 是過去分詞。

name: 過去進行式
note: 過去某時刻正在進行的動作用 was/were + V-ing,常與 when/while 搭配表被打斷。

items.q: I ___ a shower, so I didn't hear the delivery guy ring the bell.
items.ex: 過去當下正在進行用 was + V-ing;I 搭 was。

items.q: While she ___ dinner, the power went out.
items.ex: while 引導過去進行中的背景動作。

items.q: At 9 p.m. yesterday, we ___ a movie.
items.ex: 過去特定時刻正在做,we 搭 were + V-ing。

items.q: What ___ when the earthquake hit?
items.ex: 問過去當下在做什麼;you 搭 were,疑問句倒裝。

items.q: They ___ about the project when the boss walked in.
items.ex: they 複數搭 were;被 when 子句打斷的進行動作。

items.q: I ___ to work when I saw the accident.
items.ex: 開車途中看到事故,背景動作用過去進行式。

items.q: It ___ heavily, so the game was cancelled.
items.ex: 過去時間背景,it 搭 was + V-ing。

items.q: The phone rang while I ___ a meeting with a client.
items.ex: while 子句為過去進行中的動作。

items.q: He ___ on his laptop all evening, so he didn't hear me.
items.ex: he 搭 was;整晚持續進行用過去進行式。

items.q: She ___ when I called her at midnight.
items.ex: 打電話那刻她正在睡,用過去進行式。

name: will 與 be going to
note: 已決定的計畫或有跡象的預測用 be going to;當下臨時決定、承諾、看法用 will。

items.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
items.ex: 眼前有跡象的預測用 be going to,be 不可省。

items.q: “The phone's ringing.” “Don't worry, I ___ it.”
items.ex: 說話當下臨時決定用 will + 原形。

items.q: We ___ visit my parents this weekend; we've already booked the tickets.
items.ex: 已安排好的計畫用 be going to + 原形。

items.q: I think AI ___ change how we work.
items.ex: I think 後表看法預測用 will + 原形。

items.q: She ___ quit her job next month — she's already told her boss.
items.ex: 已決定的打算用 be going to。

items.q: ___ you going to attend the conference?
items.ex: be going to 的疑問句把 be 動詞提前,you 搭 Are。

items.q: I promise I ___ send you the file tonight.
items.ex: 承諾用 will + 原形。

items.q: He ___ going to buy a new car.
items.ex: be going to 的否定是在 be 動詞後加 not。

items.q: Careful! You ___ drop that laptop!
items.ex: 眼看即將發生的事用 be going to。

items.q: I'm hungry. I think I ___ order some food.
items.ex: 當下決定用 will + 原形動詞。

name: 冠詞 a / an / the
note: 第一次提到的單數可數名詞用 a/an,雙方已知或獨一無二的用 the,泛指複數或不可數不加冠詞。

items.q: I bought ___ new laptop yesterday.
items.ex: 第一次提到的單數可數名詞用 a;new 子音開頭。

items.q: She is ___ engineer at a chip company.
items.ex: engineer 母音開頭用 an;職業前要加冠詞。

items.q: Can you close ___ door, please? It's cold.
items.ex: 雙方都知道是哪扇門,用 the。

items.q: ___ sun rises in the east.
items.ex: 獨一無二的事物用 the。

items.q: ___ smartphones have changed the way people communicate.
items.ex: 泛指一類事物的複數名詞不加冠詞。

items.q: We stayed at a hotel near the beach. ___ hotel was very clean.
items.ex: 第二次提到同一間飯店,用 the。

items.q: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
items.ex: 最高級前要加 the。

items.q: It takes about ___ hour to get to the airport.
items.ex: hour 的 h 不發音,母音開頭用 an。

items.q: He usually goes to ___ bed at midnight.
items.ex: go to bed 是固定說法,不加冠詞。

items.q: It was ___ useful meeting.
items.ex: useful 發音以 /j/ 子音開頭,用 a;單數可數名詞需冠詞。

name: 可數/不可數與數量詞
note: 可數名詞用 many/a few/few,不可數用 much/a little/little;否定與疑問常用 any。

items.q: How ___ money do you need for the trip?
items.ex: money 不可數,問數量用 how much。

items.q: How ___ people work in your department?
items.ex: people 是可數複數,用 how many。

items.q: There isn't ___ milk left in the fridge.
items.ex: 否定句用 any;milk 不可數,不用 many/a few。

items.q: I have ___ questions about the contract.
items.ex: questions 可數,用 a few;a lot 後需加 of。

items.q: We don't have ___ time before the meeting, so let's be quick.
items.ex: time(時間)不可數,用 much。

items.q: I'd like ___ information about the course.
items.ex: information 不可數,不能加 an 或用 many。

items.q: She gave me ___ useful advice.
items.ex: advice 不可數,計數要用 a piece of。

items.q: There are ___ cars on the road on Sunday mornings, so it's a quick drive.
items.ex: cars 可數;few 表「很少」,與車程快相符。

items.q: I have very ___ free time these days.
items.ex: time 不可數,very little 表很少。

items.q: How ___ luggage are you bringing?
items.ex: luggage 不可數,用 how much。

name: 比較級與最高級
note: 短形容詞加 -er/-est,長形容詞用 more/most;比較用 than,最高級前加 the;good→better→best。

items.q: This phone is ___ than my old one.
items.ex: 單音節形容詞比較級加 -er,不可再加 more。

items.q: Taipei 101 was once the ___ building in the world.
items.ex: the ... in the world 用最高級,tall → tallest。

items.q: The new system is much ___ than the old one.
items.ex: 多音節形容詞用 more 形成比較級。

items.q: This is the ___ movie I've ever seen.
items.ex: bad 最高級為 worst,不規則變化。

items.q: Traffic today is ___ than yesterday.
items.ex: bad 比較級為 worse。

items.q: Train tickets are ___ expensive than plane tickets.
items.ex: less + 形容詞 + than 表「比較不…」。

items.q: She speaks English ___ than I do.
items.ex: good/well 比較級為 better。

items.q: My commute is not as long ___ yours.
items.ex: as + 形容詞 + as 表同等比較。

items.q: Kaohsiung is ___ city in southern Taiwan.
items.ex: 最高級前要加 the;big → biggest。

items.q: The ___ you practice, the better you get.
items.ex: The more…, the better… 表「越…越…」。

name: 時間介系詞
note: 時刻用 at,日期與星期用 on,月份/年份用 in;by=在…之前,since=自從,for=一段時間。

items.q: The meeting starts ___ 10 a.m.
items.ex: 確切時刻用 at。

items.q: My birthday is ___ March.
items.ex: 月份前用 in。

items.q: I'll see you ___ Monday.
items.ex: 星期幾前用 on。

items.q: The shop is closed ___ Christmas Day.
items.ex: 特定某一天(Christmas Day)用 on。

items.q: She was born ___ 1995.
items.ex: 年份前用 in。

items.q: I can't sleep ___ night when I drink coffee.
items.ex: at night 是固定用法。

items.q: The project must be finished ___ Friday.
items.ex: by 表「最晚在…之前」完成;until 表持續到。

items.q: I've worked here ___ 2020.
items.ex: 現在完成式 + 起始時間點用 since。

items.q: I waited ___ two hours at the airport.
items.ex: 一段時間長度用 for。

items.q: The store opens ___ the morning of the 5th.
items.ex: 特定日期的早上用 on,而非 in the morning。

name: 地點介系詞
note: 在某個點用 at,在表面上用 on,在空間內部或城市國家用 in;樓層用 on。

items.q: She lives ___ Taichung.
items.ex: 城市前用 in。

items.q: I'll meet you ___ the bus stop.
items.ex: 約在某個地點(點)用 at。

items.q: Your keys are ___ the table.
items.ex: 在表面上用 on。

items.q: He's ___ the meeting room right now.
items.ex: 在房間內部用 in;into 表移動方向。

items.q: I read about it ___ the newspaper.
items.ex: 報紙、書本內容用 in。

items.q: There's a pharmacy ___ the corner of this street.
items.ex: 街角用 on/at the corner;in the corner 指室內角落。

items.q: Our office is ___ the 12th floor.
items.ex: 樓層用 on。

items.q: I saw her ___ the airport.
items.ex: 在某個場所(點)用 at。

items.q: Please write your name ___ the top of the page.
items.ex: at the top of 是固定用法。

items.q: He arrived ___ Tokyo late last night.
items.ex: arrive 到城市用 in;arrive 不接 to。

name: 義務情態動詞 must / have to
note: must/have to=必須;mustn't=禁止;don't have to=不必;過去必須用 had to。

items.q: You ___ smoke inside the building. It's against the law.
items.ex: 違法=禁止,用 mustn't + 原形。

items.q: It's Saturday, so I ___ get up early.
items.ex: 週六不必早起,用 don't have to(不必)。

items.q: All visitors ___ wear a badge.
items.ex: must 後直接接原形,不加 s 或 to。

items.q: She ___ work late yesterday to finish the report.
items.ex: must 沒有過去式,過去的必須用 had to。

items.q: You ___ bring anything to the party; we have plenty of food.
items.ex: 不必帶,用 don't need to;needn't 後不加 to。

items.q: Do we ___ book a table in advance?
items.ex: Do 疑問句後接 have to 原形。

items.q: You look tired. You ___ get some rest.
items.ex: 給建議用 should + 原形;ought 需加 to。

items.q: Employees ___ to report any security incidents immediately.
items.ex: 空格後有 to,用 have to;employees 複數。

items.q: I ___ to take the train because my car broke down.
items.ex: 過去的必要用 had to。

items.q: Passengers ___ use their phones during takeoff.
items.ex: 禁止用 aren't allowed to;don't have to 是不必。

name: 疑問句與助動詞
note: 一般動詞疑問句要加 do/does/did;疑問詞本身當主詞時不需助動詞。

items.q: Where ___ you live?
items.ex: you 一般動詞疑問句用 do。

items.q: What time ___ the store close?
items.ex: the store 單數,用 does + 原形。

items.q: Who ___ the email to the client yesterday?
items.ex: who 是主詞,不需助動詞,直接用過去式。

items.q: How long ___ it take to get to the airport?
items.ex: it 單數,一般動詞 take 用 does。

items.q: ___ you finish the report yesterday?
items.ex: yesterday 過去式疑問句用 Did + 原形。

items.q: What ___ at the meeting yesterday?
items.ex: what 當主詞,直接用過去式 happened。

items.q: ___ she work in the marketing department?
items.ex: she 第三人稱單數,用 Does + 原形。

items.q: Why ___ you at the office yesterday?
items.ex: 句中無一般動詞,用 be 動詞;you 搭 were。

items.q: How many people ___ to the conference last year?
items.ex: how many people 是主詞,直接用過去式。

items.q: Which bus ___ to the airport?
items.ex: which bus 是主詞,不需 does,動詞加 -es。

name: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式
note: 有明確過去時間用過去式;經驗、到目前為止、與現在相關的結果用現在完成式。

items.q: I ___ to Japan three times so far.
items.ex: so far 表到目前為止的經驗,用現在完成式。

items.q: She ___ the company in 2019.
items.ex: in 2019 是明確過去時間,用過去式。

items.q: Have you ever ___ stinky tofu?
items.ex: Have you ever 後接過去分詞 eaten。

items.q: When ___ you start working here?
items.ex: when 問過去時間點,不可用現在完成式。

items.q: The CEO ___ his resignation yesterday.
items.ex: yesterday 搭配過去式。

items.q: I ___ that movie last weekend.
items.ex: last weekend 是明確過去時間,用過去式。

items.q: I've ___ finished the report, so you can review it now.
items.ex: 肯定句「已經」用 already;yet 用於否定與疑問。

items.q: Prices ___ a lot since last year.
items.ex: since 表從過去到現在,用現在完成式。

items.q: My grandfather ___ in a factory for 40 years before he retired.
items.ex: 已退休,事情已完全結束,用過去式。

items.q: Has she replied to your email ___?
items.ex: 疑問句句尾「了嗎」用 yet。

name: for 與 since
note: for + 一段時間,since + 起始時間點或子句;表持續到現在時搭配現在完成式。

items.q: I've lived in Hsinchu ___ 2018.
items.ex: 2018 是起始時間點,用 since。

items.q: She's been a software engineer ___ ten years.
items.ex: ten years 是時間長度,用 for。

items.q: We've known each other ___ we were in college.
items.ex: since 可接子句,表從那時起。

items.q: I haven't seen him ___ ages.
items.ex: ages 表很長一段時間,用 for。

items.q: How long ___ you worked here?
items.ex: 問持續到現在多久,用 have + p.p.。

items.q: They ___ married for five years.
items.ex: 婚姻持續到現在五年,用 have been。

items.q: It's been three years ___ I last visited my hometown.
items.ex: It's been + 時間 + since + 過去式。

items.q: I've had this phone ___ last Christmas.
items.ex: last Christmas 是時間點,用 since。

items.q: He ___ in Taipei since 2015.
items.ex: since 2015 至今,用現在完成式。

items.q: We ___ each other since university.
items.ex: since 搭現在完成式;know 不用進行式。

name: 現在完成進行式
note: have/has been + V-ing 強調從過去持續到現在的動作及其時長;講完成數量則用現在完成式。

items.q: I ___ for you for 30 minutes! Where were you?
items.ex: 從過去一直等到現在,強調持續用完成進行式。

items.q: She looks tired because she ___ all day.
items.ex: 持續到現在的動作造成現在的結果;she 用 has。

items.q: How long ___ you been learning English?
items.ex: How long have you been + V-ing 問持續多久。

items.q: It ___ raining since this morning.
items.ex: since 搭完成進行式;it 用 has。

items.q: They've been ___ this bug for three days and still haven't fixed it.
items.ex: have been 後接 V-ing。

items.q: My eyes hurt. I ___ at the screen all day.
items.ex: 持續動作導致現在眼睛痛;I 用 have。

items.q: He ___ at this company since 2020.
items.ex: since 2020 持續到現在,不用現在式。

items.q: I ___ three emails this morning.
items.ex: 講完成的數量用現在完成式,不用進行式。

items.q: We've been ___ about moving to Taichung.
items.ex: have been 後接 V-ing。

items.q: The kids are dirty because they ___ in the garden.
items.ex: 剛才持續的活動留下痕跡,用完成進行式。

name: 過去完成式
note: 在過去某時間點之前就已完成的動作用 had + 過去分詞。

items.q: When I arrived at the station, the train ___ already left.
items.ex: 火車在我到站前已開走,用 had + p.p.。

items.q: She didn't come to dinner because she ___ already eaten.
items.ex: 比過去更早發生的事用過去完成式。

items.q: I ___ never seen snow before I went to Hokkaido.
items.ex: 去北海道之前的經驗,用 had + p.p.。

items.q: By the time we got to the cinema, the movie ___.
items.ex: By the time + 過去式,主句用過去完成式。

items.q: He realized he ___ his passport at home.
items.ex: 忘帶護照發生在發覺之前,用 had left。

items.q: After she ___ the report, she went home.
items.ex: 先完成報告再回家,較早的動作用 had + p.p.。

items.q: The meeting ___ ended by the time I logged in.
items.ex: 登入前會議已結束,用 had already + p.p.。

items.q: I couldn't log in because I ___ my password.
items.ex: 忘記密碼發生在無法登入之前。

items.q: They ___ each other for years before they got married.
items.ex: 結婚之前持續認識多年,用 had + p.p.。

items.q: It was the first time I ___ a presentation in English.
items.ex: It was the first time 後用過去完成式。

name: 未來時間子句
note: when/after/before/as soon as/until/once 引導的未來時間子句用現在式,不用 will。

items.q: I'll call you when I ___ at the airport.
items.ex: when 時間子句表未來時用現在式。

items.q: As soon as the meeting ___, we'll go for lunch.
items.ex: as soon as 子句用現在式;meeting 單數加 -es。

items.q: We'll wait here until the rain ___.
items.ex: until 子句表未來用現在式。

items.q: Before you ___ the office, please turn off the lights.
items.ex: before 子句用現在式表未來。

items.q: I'll send you the files after I ___ them.
items.ex: after 子句不用 will,用現在式。

items.q: When she ___ her degree, she'll look for a job in Singapore.
items.ex: when 子句用現在式;she 加 -s。

items.q: I won't make a decision until I ___ to my manager.
items.ex: until 子句用現在式表未來。

items.q: Text me as soon as you ___ home.
items.ex: as soon as 子句用現在式。

items.q: Once the update ___ installed, the app will restart.
items.ex: once 子句表未來用現在式 is。

items.q: If I see Tom tomorrow, I ___ him the news.
items.ex: 主句表未來用 will;條件子句才用現在式。

name: 零與第一條件句
note: 零條件句(普遍事實)If + 現在式, 現在式;第一條件句(可能發生)If + 現在式, will + 原形。

items.q: If it ___ tomorrow, we'll cancel the hike.
items.ex: if 子句表未來用現在式;it 加 -s。

items.q: If you heat ice, it ___.
items.ex: 普遍事實用零條件句,兩邊都用現在式。

items.q: If you don't hurry, you ___ the train.
items.ex: 真實可能的未來結果用 will + 原形。

items.q: Unless you ___ the bug, the app will keep crashing.
items.ex: unless=if not,本身已含否定,後接肯定現在式。

items.q: I'll lend you my car if you ___ careful.
items.ex: 第一條件句 if 子句用現在式。

items.q: If you press this button, the machine ___.
items.ex: 必然結果用零條件句,主句用現在式。

items.q: What ___ you do if the client says no?
items.ex: 可能發生的情況,主句用 will。

items.q: If the price ___ below NT$100, I'll buy some shares.
items.ex: if 子句用現在式;price 單數加 -s。

items.q: We won't finish on time ___ we get more help.
items.ex: 除非得到幫助才能完成,用 unless。

items.q: If you mix blue and yellow, you ___ green.
items.ex: 普遍事實用零條件句,現在式。

name: 第二條件句
note: 與現在事實相反或不太可能的假設:If + 過去式, would/could + 原形;be 動詞常用 were。

items.q: If I ___ more money, I would buy a house in Taipei.
items.ex: 與現在事實相反,if 子句用過去式。

items.q: If I ___ you, I'd take the job offer.
items.ex: If I were you 是給建議的固定句型。

items.q: What would you do if you ___ the lottery?
items.ex: 不太可能的假設,if 子句用過去式。

items.q: If she lived closer, she ___ to the office every day.
items.ex: 主句用 would + 原形。

items.q: I ___ more if I didn't have to work overtime.
items.ex: if 子句為過去式,主句用 would + 原形。

items.q: If we ___ a car, we could drive to Kenting.
items.ex: 現在沒車的假設,if 子句用過去式。

items.q: He would understand the problem if he ___ the manual.
items.ex: if 子句用過去式 read;不用 would。

items.q: If I knew her number, I ___ her.
items.ex: 與現在相反的假設,主句用 would + 原形。

items.q: ___ I had more time, I would learn Japanese.
items.ex: 假設語氣用 If 引導。

items.q: If the company ___ remote work, more people would apply.
items.ex: 主句是 would,if 子句用過去式。

name: 被動語態(基本)
note: 被動語態 = be + 過去分詞,強調動作承受者;時態由 be 動詞表現。

items.q: This bridge ___ in 1990.
items.ex: 橋是被建造的,過去被動用 was + p.p.。

items.q: English ___ in many countries.
items.ex: 語言被說,現在被動 is + p.p.。

items.q: The report ___ by the manager every Friday.
items.ex: by the manager 表被動;每週習慣用現在式。

items.q: My bike ___ last night.
items.ex: 腳踏車被偷,過去被動 was + stolen。

items.q: The results ___ next week.
items.ex: 未來被動 will be + p.p.。

items.q: The meeting ___ until Thursday.
items.ex: 會議被延期,完成式被動 has been + p.p.。

items.q: Most smartphones ___ in Asia.
items.ex: 手機被製造,現在被動 are + p.p.。

items.q: Smoking is not ___ in this restaurant.
items.ex: be allowed 是被動,接過去分詞。

items.q: These photos ___ by my sister.
items.ex: 照片被拍,複數過去被動 were + taken。

items.q: The package ___ to the wrong address.
items.ex: 包裹是被寄送的,用 was + p.p.。

name: 間接引述
note: 轉述過去說的話時態常往後退(現在→過去、will→would),疑問句改直述語序,時間詞也要調整。

items.q: Yesterday she said that she ___ too tired to go out that night.
items.ex: 轉述過去的話且指當晚,現在式退為過去式。

items.q: He told me he ___ call me the next day.
items.ex: 轉述時 will 退為 would;the next day 為轉述時間詞。

items.q: “I'm working from home.” → She said she ___ from home that day.
items.ex: 現在進行式退為過去進行式。

items.q: He asked me where I ___.
items.ex: 間接疑問句用直述語序,不加助動詞。

items.q: She asked me ___ I had finished the report.
items.ex: 轉述 Yes/No 問句用 if/whether。

items.q: The manager told us ___ late again.
items.ex: 轉述否定命令:tell sb not to + 原形。

items.q: He ___ me that the project was delayed.
items.ex: tell 後直接接人;say 不直接接人。

items.q: She ___ that she needed more time.
items.ex: 後面沒有接人時用 said that。

items.q: They asked me when the meeting ___.
items.ex: 間接疑問句主詞在前、動詞在後,不倒裝。

items.q: “I bought a new phone yesterday.” → He said he ___ a new phone the day before.
items.ex: 過去式轉述時退為過去完成式。

name: 限定關係子句
note: 指人用 who/that,指物用 which/that,所有格用 whose,地點用 where,時間用 when。

items.q: The engineer ___ fixed the server got a bonus.
items.ex: 先行詞是人且當主詞,用 who。

items.q: This is the laptop ___ I bought last week.
items.ex: 先行詞是物,用 that/which;what 不能接先行詞。

items.q: I have a colleague ___ wife is a doctor.
items.ex: 表「他的太太」所有關係,用 whose。

items.q: That's the café ___ we first met.
items.ex: 地點且子句完整,用 where。

items.q: The app ___ I use most is LINE.
items.ex: 先行詞是物,用 that。

items.q: Do you know anyone ___ speaks Korean?
items.ex: anyone 指人,用 who。

items.q: I'll never forget the day ___ I started this job.
items.ex: 先行詞為時間且子句完整,用 when。

items.q: Students ___ grades are below 60 must retake the exam.
items.ex: 「他們的成績」所有格,用 whose。

items.q: The book ___ is on the desk belongs to me.
items.ex: 先行詞是物且當主詞,用 which/that。

items.q: What's the name of the hotel ___ you stayed at?
items.ex: 句尾已有 at,不能再用 where;用 that/which。

name: 動名詞 vs 不定詞
note: enjoy/avoid/finish/mind/look forward to 後接 V-ing;want/decide/plan/forget(未做)後接 to V。

items.q: I enjoy ___ in the mountains on weekends.
items.ex: enjoy 後接動名詞。

items.q: She decided ___ a new job.
items.ex: decide 後接 to + 原形。

items.q: Would you mind ___ the window?
items.ex: mind 後接動名詞。

items.q: We're planning ___ to Japan in spring.
items.ex: plan 後接 to + 原形。

items.q: He avoided ___ the question.
items.ex: avoid 後接動名詞。

items.q: I'm looking forward to ___ you next week.
items.ex: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞,接 V-ing。

items.q: She finished ___ the report at midnight.
items.ex: finish 後接動名詞。

items.q: Don't forget ___ the door when you leave.
items.ex: forget to V=忘記要去做(尚未做)。

items.q: I stopped ___ coffee because it kept me awake.
items.ex: stop V-ing=戒掉;stop to V=停下來去做。

items.q: It's no use ___ about it now.
items.ex: It's no use 後接動名詞。

name: used to / be used to
note: used to + 原形=過去的習慣(現已不再);be/get used to + V-ing=習慣於某事。

items.q: I ___ smoke, but I quit five years ago.
items.ex: 過去習慣、現已不再,用 used to + 原形。

items.q: She ___ working night shifts, so she doesn't mind.
items.ex: 習慣於某事用 be used to + V-ing。

items.q: Did you ___ live in Tainan?
items.ex: did 之後用原形 use to。

items.q: It took me a while to get used to ___ on the left in the UK.
items.ex: get used to 的 to 是介系詞,接 V-ing。

items.q: We ___ have a lot of meetings, but now we mostly use Slack.
items.ex: 過去常常、現在不再,用 used to + 原形。

items.q: I'm not used to ___ up so early.
items.ex: be used to 後接 V-ing。

items.q: There ___ be a cinema here, but it closed.
items.ex: 過去存在現已不在:There used to be。

items.q: He'll soon get used ___ the new system.
items.ex: get used to + 名詞,介系詞是 to。

items.q: I didn't ___ like spicy food, but now I love it.
items.ex: didn't 後用原形 use to。

items.q: Are you ___ to the noise yet?
items.ex: be used to = 習慣於。

name: 附加問句
note: 肯定句接否定附加問句,否定句接肯定附加問句;助動詞與時態須和主句一致。

items.q: You're coming to the meeting, ___?
items.ex: 主句 are 肯定,附加問句用 aren't you。

items.q: She works in finance, ___?
items.ex: 一般動詞現在式第三人稱,用 doesn't she。

items.q: They didn't call, ___?
items.ex: 否定句接肯定附加問句,時態過去用 did。

items.q: He has finished the report, ___?
items.ex: 主句助動詞 has,附加問句用 hasn't he。

items.q: Let's grab lunch, ___?
items.ex: Let's 開頭的附加問句用 shall we。

items.q: I'm late, ___?
items.ex: I am 的否定附加問句是特例 aren't I。

items.q: You can't swim, ___?
items.ex: 否定句接肯定附加問句,沿用 can。

items.q: It was a great presentation, ___?
items.ex: 主句 was 肯定,用 wasn't it。

items.q: Nobody called, ___?
items.ex: nobody 視為否定,附加問句用肯定,代名詞用 they。

items.q: You'll send me the file, ___?
items.ex: 主句 will 肯定,用 won't you。

name: 情態推測(現在)
note: must=幾乎確定是;can't=確定不可能;might/may/could=可能。推測的否定用 can't 而非 mustn't。

items.q: She's been working 12 hours straight. She ___ be exhausted.
items.ex: 有充分證據的肯定推測用 must。

items.q: That ___ be Tom at the door; he's in Japan this week.
items.ex: 確定不可能用 can't;mustn't 是禁止。

items.q: I'm not sure where she is. She ___ be in a meeting.
items.ex: 不確定的推測用 might。

items.q: All the lights are off and nobody answers. They ___ be at home.
items.ex: 證據顯示不在家,否定推測用 can't。

items.q: He ___ be rich — he drives a Ferrari and lives in Xinyi.
items.ex: 有明確證據的肯定推測用 must。

items.q: This ___ be the right address. There's no building here.
items.ex: 否定推測用 can't。

items.q: Take an umbrella; it ___ rain later.
items.ex: 不確定的可能性用 might。

items.q: A free MacBook for every employee? You ___ be joking!
items.ex: You must be joking 表「你一定在開玩笑」。

items.q: The package ___ arrive today or tomorrow; the tracking isn't clear.
items.ex: 不確定的可能性用 may。

items.q: He isn't answering his phone. He ___ be asleep.
items.ex: 可能的解釋用 might + 原形。

name: 第三條件句
note: 與過去事實相反的假設:If + had p.p., would/could have + p.p.。

items.q: If I ___ earlier, I wouldn't have missed the flight.
items.ex: 與過去相反,if 子句用 had + p.p.。

items.q: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam last year.
items.ex: 主句用 would have + p.p.。

items.q: We ___ the deal if we had lowered the price.
items.ex: 過去假設的結果用 would have + p.p.。

items.q: If you had told me about the problem, I ___ you.
items.ex: 過去本來能做到,用 could have + p.p.。

items.q: If the alarm ___ off, I would have overslept.
items.ex: 與過去事實相反的 if 子句用 hadn't + p.p.。

items.q: What would you have done if you ___ the job?
items.ex: 第三條件句 if 子句用 had + p.p.。

items.q: I wouldn't have bought this phone if I ___ the reviews.
items.ex: if 子句不用 would,用 had + p.p.。

items.q: If they ___ the bug earlier, the system wouldn't have crashed.
items.ex: if 子句用過去完成式。

items.q: She would have come to the party if she ___ invited.
items.ex: 被動的過去假設:had been + p.p.。

items.q: If it hadn't rained, we ___ the game.
items.ex: 主句用 would have + p.p.。

name: 混合條件句
note: 過去條件影響現在:If + had p.p., would + 原形(now);現在狀態影響過去:If + 過去式, would have p.p.。

items.q: If I had taken that job, I ___ in London now.
items.ex: 過去的選擇影響現在(now),主句用 would + 原形。

items.q: If she hadn't missed the flight, she ___ here now.
items.ex: now 表現在結果,用 would be。

items.q: If I ___ better at math, I would have studied engineering.
items.ex: 現在的特質影響過去,if 子句用過去式 were。

items.q: If we had invested in that stock in 2010, we ___ rich today.
items.ex: today 表現在結果,用 would + 原形。

items.q: He ___ so tired now if he had gone to bed earlier.
items.ex: 過去行為影響現在狀態,用 wouldn't be。

items.q: If I didn't trust you, I ___ you the password last week.
items.ex: 現在的信任影響過去行為,用 would have + p.p.。

items.q: If she spoke Japanese, she ___ the job in Tokyo last year.
items.ex: last year 是過去結果,用 would have + p.p.。

items.q: If you ___ the instructions, the machine wouldn't be broken now.
items.ex: 過去沒照做影響現在,if 子句用 had + p.p.。

items.q: I would be a manager now if I ___ the company ten years ago.
items.ex: ten years ago 的假設用 had + p.p.。

items.q: If he weren't so stubborn, he ___ our advice last week.
items.ex: 現在個性影響上週行為,用 would have + p.p.。

name: 過去情態(推測與遺憾)
note: must have p.p.=過去肯定推測;can't have=不可能;should have=該做卻沒做;could have=本來可以;needn't have=其實不必。

items.q: The ground is wet. It ___ rained last night.
items.ex: 對過去的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.。

items.q: You ___ told me you were vegetarian! I'd have cooked something else.
items.ex: 該做卻沒做,用 should have + p.p.。

items.q: She ___ seen me; she walked right past without saying hi.
items.ex: 對過去的否定推測用 can't have + p.p.。

items.q: I ___ studied harder for the exam. I failed.
items.ex: 表後悔沒做,用 should have + p.p.。

items.q: We ___ taken a taxi, but we decided to walk.
items.ex: 過去本來可以但沒做,用 could have + p.p.。

items.q: He ___ left already; his coat isn't here.
items.ex: 有證據的過去推測用 must have + p.p.。

items.q: You ___ bought milk; we already had two bottles.
items.ex: 做了但其實不必,用 needn't have + p.p.。

items.q: They ___ forgotten the meeting — I reminded them twice this morning.
items.ex: 確定不可能忘記,用 can't have + p.p.。

items.q: She finally got the promotion she wanted for years. She ___ been thrilled.
items.ex: 合理推測她當時很開心,用 must have been。

items.q: I ___ my umbrella on the train. I can't find it anywhere.
items.ex: 對過去的不確定推測用 might have + p.p.。

name: 被動語態(進階)
note: 進行被動 be being p.p.;完成被動 have been p.p.;情態被動 modal + be p.p.;It is said that / be believed to have p.p.。

items.q: The road ___ repaired at the moment, so use another route.
items.ex: at the moment 正在被修,用 is being + p.p.。

items.q: The new policy ___ announced next week.
items.ex: 未來被動用 will be + p.p.。

items.q: All passwords must ___ every 90 days.
items.ex: 情態動詞被動:must be + p.p.。

items.q: The documents ___ signed before the deadline passed.
items.ex: 過去某時之前被完成,用 had been + p.p.。

items.q: The suspect is believed ___ the country last week.
items.ex: be believed to have p.p. 表推測過去的事。

items.q: I don't like ___ what to do.
items.ex: like 後接動名詞被動 being + p.p.。

items.q: The hotel ___ since last year.
items.ex: since 搭現在完成被動 has been + p.p.。

items.q: My car ___ serviced when I called the garage, so I had to wait.
items.ex: 過去當下正被保養,用 was being + p.p.。

items.q: It ___ that the company will cut 500 jobs.
items.ex: It is reported that… 是新聞常用被動句型。

items.q: This problem should ___ dealt with immediately.
items.ex: should be + p.p. 表應該被處理。

name: 使役動詞 have / get / make
note: have/get + 物 + p.p.=請人處理;have sb do;get sb to do;make sb do=迫使。

items.q: I need to ___ my hair cut before the interview.
items.ex: have + 物 + p.p. 表請別人做。

items.q: We had the air conditioner ___ last week.
items.ex: 冷氣是被修,have + 物 + 過去分詞。

items.q: She got her brother ___ her move.
items.ex: get + 人 + to V 表說服某人做。

items.q: I'll have my assistant ___ you the details.
items.ex: have + 人 + 原形動詞。

items.q: He had his phone ___ on the train.
items.ex: have + 物 + p.p. 也可表遭遇不幸。

items.q: Where do you ___ your car serviced?
items.ex: get + 物 + p.p. 表請人處理。

items.q: I'm going to get my eyes ___ next week.
items.ex: 眼睛被檢查,get + 物 + p.p.。

items.q: The manager made us ___ the whole report again.
items.ex: make + 人 + 原形動詞(主動)。

items.q: Can you get the IT team ___ my laptop?
items.ex: get + 人 + to V。

items.q: We're having our kitchen ___ next month.
items.ex: 廚房被重新設計,have + 物 + p.p.。

name: wish / if only
note: 對現在的遺憾:wish + 過去式;對過去的遺憾:wish + had p.p.;希望別人改變行為:wish + would。

items.q: I wish I ___ more time to travel.
items.ex: 對現在的遺憾用 wish + 過去式。

items.q: I wish I ___ that email; my boss was furious.
items.ex: 對過去的後悔用 wish + had p.p.。

items.q: If only I ___ speak Japanese!
items.ex: 現在做不到的遺憾,用 could。

items.q: I wish you ___ stop interrupting me.
items.ex: 希望別人改變惱人行為,用 wish + would。

items.q: She wishes she ___ in a bigger apartment.
items.ex: 與現在事實相反,用過去式。

items.q: If only we ___ the earlier train — we'd be home by now.
items.ex: 對過去的遺憾用 had + p.p.。

items.q: I wish it ___ raining. I want to go out.
items.ex: 希望情況改變,用 wish + would。

items.q: Do you ever wish you ___ a different career when you were young?
items.ex: 對過去選擇的遺憾用 had + p.p.。

items.q: I wish I ___ so tired right now.
items.ex: right now 現在的遺憾,用過去式 weren't。

items.q: He wishes he ___ invested in Bitcoin ten years ago.
items.ex: ten years ago 的遺憾用 had + p.p.。

name: 非限定關係子句
note: 非限定子句以逗號隔開補充資訊,不可用 that;指人 who/whom、物 which,也可用 which 指整句。

items.q: My boss, ___ is from Canada, speaks fluent Chinese.
items.ex: 非限定子句指人當主詞,用 who,不可用 that。

items.q: Taipei 101, ___ was completed in 2004, is a famous landmark.
items.ex: 逗號後補充說明物,用 which。

items.q: She failed the test, ___ surprised everyone.
items.ex: which 可指前面整句話。

items.q: My sister, ___ husband is a pilot, travels a lot.
items.ex: 「她的丈夫」所有格,用 whose。

items.q: The conference was held in Kaohsiung, ___ I grew up.
items.ex: 地點且子句完整,用 where。

items.q: Our CEO, ___ I met last year, is retiring.
items.ex: 指人當受詞且有逗號,用 whom(或 who),不可用 that。

items.q: The new model, ___ costs NT$30,000, is selling well.
items.ex: 逗號後不可用 that,指物用 which。

items.q: I spoke to Mr. Lin, ___ advised me to wait.
items.ex: 指人當主詞用 who;whom 只當受詞。

items.q: He offered to pay, ___ was very kind of him.
items.ex: which 指前面整件事。

items.q: We visited Tainan in 2024, ___ the city was celebrating its 400th anniversary.
items.ex: 先行詞為時間且子句完整,用 when。

name: 分詞構句
note: 分詞構句:主動用 V-ing,被動用 p.p.,先完成用 Having p.p.;分詞的邏輯主詞須與主句主詞相同。

items.q: ___ the report, she sent it to her boss.
items.ex: 先完成再寄出,用 Having + p.p.。

items.q: ___ in 1902, the building is one of the oldest in the city.
items.ex: 建築是被建造的,用過去分詞。

items.q: ___ down the street, I saw an old friend.
items.ex: 主詞 I 主動走路,用現在分詞。

items.q: ___ by the news, he couldn't say a word.
items.ex: 他是被震驚的,用過去分詞。

items.q: The man ___ next to me on the plane was a doctor.
items.ex: 現在分詞修飾名詞,相當於 who was sitting。

items.q: Products ___ in Taiwan are known for their quality.
items.ex: 產品被製造,過去分詞修飾名詞。

items.q: ___ what to do, I called my manager.
items.ex: 分詞構句否定把 not 放在分詞前。

items.q: ___ three languages, she was perfect for the job.
items.ex: 她主動會說三種語言,用現在分詞。

items.q: The email ___ yesterday contained a virus.
items.ex: 郵件是被寄出的,過去分詞修飾名詞。

items.q: ___ for ten hours straight, I was too tired to cook.
items.ex: 先工作再疲累,用 Having + p.p.。

name: 未來進行式與未來完成式
note: will be V-ing=未來某時正在進行;will have p.p.=在未來某時之前已完成。

items.q: By 2030, I ___ here for ten years.
items.ex: By + 未來時間,表到時已累積,用 will have + p.p.。

items.q: This time tomorrow, I ___ on a beach in Bali.
items.ex: 明天此刻正在進行,用 will be + V-ing。

items.q: Don't call me at 8; I ___ dinner with my clients then.
items.ex: 未來某時正在進行,用未來進行式。

items.q: By the time you arrive, we ___ the meeting.
items.ex: By the time 你到時已完成,用 will have + p.p.。

items.q: The project ___ by the end of the month.
items.ex: 專案是被完成的,用未來完成被動。

items.q: By noon, she ___ 30 km.
items.ex: By noon 前已完成的量,用 will have + p.p.。

items.q: ___ you be using the car tonight? I need it.
items.ex: 未來進行式疑問:Will you be + V-ing。

items.q: At 3 p.m. tomorrow, we ___ the new system to the client.
items.ex: 明天三點正在進行,用 will be + V-ing。

items.q: I ___ my degree by next June.
items.ex: by + 未來時間,用 will have + p.p.。

items.q: Next year my parents ___ married for 40 years.
items.ex: 到明年累積 40 年,用 will have been。

name: 轉折連接詞
note: although/even though + 子句;despite/in spite of + 名詞或 V-ing;however/nevertheless 是副詞,接在句號或分號後並加逗號。

items.q: ___ the rain, we went hiking.
items.ex: 後接名詞 the rain,用 Despite。

items.q: ___ it was raining, we went hiking.
items.ex: 後接完整子句,用 Although。

items.q: She got the job ___ having little experience.
items.ex: 後接 V-ing,用 despite。

items.q: The plan is good. ___, it's too expensive.
items.ex: 句號後轉折用副詞 However + 逗號。

items.q: In spite ___ the delay, the project was a success.
items.ex: in spite of 固定搭配。

items.q: He kept working ___ he was exhausted.
items.ex: 後接子句,用 even though。

items.q: ___ being tired, she finished the report.
items.ex: 後接動名詞,用 Despite。

items.q: The hotel was cheap; ___, it was very clean.
items.ex: 分號後接副詞 nevertheless + 逗號。

items.q: ___ the fact that he's rich, he lives simply.
items.ex: despite the fact that + 子句。

items.q: Prices rose, ___ demand stayed strong.
items.ex: 逗號連接兩個子句用對等連接詞 but。

name: 否定副詞倒裝
note: Never、Rarely、Seldom、Hardly、Not only、Only after、Little 等否定或限定詞放句首時,主詞與助動詞倒裝。

items.q: Never ___ such a beautiful sunset.
items.ex: Never 放句首,助動詞 have 移到主詞前。

items.q: Not only ___ late, but he also forgot the slides.
items.ex: Not only 放句首要倒裝:was he。

items.q: Hardly ___ sat down when the phone rang.
items.ex: Hardly had + 主詞 + p.p. … when …。

items.q: Rarely ___ such a strong candidate.
items.ex: Rarely 句首,一般動詞需加 do 倒裝。

items.q: Only after the meeting ___ how serious the problem was.
items.ex: Only after… 放句首,主句倒裝 did + 主詞。

items.q: No sooner had we left ___ it started to rain.
items.ex: No sooner… than… 是固定搭配。

items.q: Under no circumstances ___ share your password.
items.ex: 否定片語句首倒裝,且不可再加否定。

items.q: Little ___ that the company was about to collapse.
items.ex: Little 句首表「完全不知道」,用 did + 主詞倒裝。

items.q: Not until I moved abroad ___ how much I missed home.
items.ex: Not until… 放句首,主句倒裝。

items.q: Seldom ___ he take a day off.
items.ex: Seldom 句首,第三人稱單數用 does 倒裝。

name: 條件句倒裝
note: 正式語中可省略 if 並倒裝:Should you…(第一)、Were I… / Were it not for(第二)、Had I…(第三)。

items.q: ___ you have any questions, please contact us.
items.ex: Should you… = If you…,正式信件常用。

items.q: ___ I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
items.ex: Had I known = If I had known。

items.q: ___ I in your position, I would accept the offer.
items.ex: Were I… = If I were…,倒裝只用 were。

items.q: Had she ___ the warning, she wouldn't have invested.
items.ex: Had + 主詞 + 過去分詞。

items.q: ___ the company fail to pay, legal action will be taken.
items.ex: Should + 主詞 + 原形,表萬一。

items.q: Were the price ___ drop, demand would rise.
items.ex: Were + 主詞 + to V 表假設未來。

items.q: ___ it not been for your help, we would have failed.
items.ex: Had it not been for = 若不是(過去)。

items.q: ___ it not for the internet, remote work would be impossible.
items.ex: Were it not for = 若不是(現在)。

items.q: Should you ___ to cancel, please notify us 24 hours in advance.
items.ex: Should + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

items.q: Had we left earlier, we ___ the traffic.
items.ex: 第三條件句倒裝,主句用 would have + p.p.。

name: 假設語氣(原形動詞)
note: suggest/recommend/insist/demand/request 及 It is essential/important that 後接原形動詞(should 可省略);It's high time / would rather + 過去式。

items.q: The doctor recommended that he ___ smoking.
items.ex: recommend that 後用原形動詞。

items.q: It is essential that every employee ___ the training.
items.ex: It is essential that + 主詞 + 原形。

items.q: She insisted that the meeting ___ postponed.
items.ex: insist 表要求時,子句用原形 be。

items.q: I suggest that she ___ a lawyer.
items.ex: suggest that 後用原形動詞,不加 -s。

items.q: The board demanded that the CEO ___ immediately.
items.ex: demand that 後用原形動詞。

items.q: It's important that he ___ late again.
items.ex: 假設語氣否定為 not + 原形。

items.q: They requested that all phones ___ switched off.
items.ex: request that 後用原形 be + p.p.。

items.q: It is vital that the data ___ kept confidential.
items.ex: It is vital that 後用原形 be。

items.q: I'd rather you ___ smoke in here.
items.ex: would rather + 人 + 過去式,表希望別人。

items.q: It's high time we ___ a decision.
items.ex: It's high time + 主詞 + 過去式。

name: 分裂句(強調句)
note: It is/was … that/who … 強調句中某部分;What … is/was … 把重點移到句尾。

items.q: It was John ___ broke the printer.
items.ex: 強調人且當主詞,用 who(或 that)。

items.q: ___ I need is a good night's sleep.
items.ex: What I need is… 表「我需要的是…」。

items.q: It was in 2008 ___ the company went public.
items.ex: It was + 強調部分 + that…。

items.q: What surprised me ___ his attitude.
items.ex: What 子句當主詞視為單數,過去用 was。

items.q: ___ was the price that made me hesitate.
items.ex: 強調句型 It was … that …。

items.q: All I want ___ a quiet weekend.
items.ex: All I want 視為單數主詞,用 is。

items.q: What she did ___ call the police.
items.ex: What + 主詞 + did + was + 原形。

items.q: It's not the money ___ matters; it's the experience.
items.ex: It's not X that… 強調句用 that。

items.q: The reason ___ I'm calling is to confirm the booking.
items.ex: The reason why… is… 為固定句型。

items.q: What I don't understand ___ why he quit.
items.ex: What 子句當主詞,接 is。
